text: The town gathers
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, and Terra, and nobody knows who the killers are.

name: Gemma
text: i hope i don't wake up to a crime scene.

name: Luna
text: I hope I get a quiet weekend with good food.

name: Sol
text: I want to keep the mood easy.

name: Sonnet
text: Just small talk before the real game starts, nothing to read into yet.

name: Terra
text: I should keep this simple.

name: Haiku
text: Luna's the killer I was shown, so I need to push her quietly without sounding like the officer.

name: Sonnet
text: Bit overcast this morning in Palermo, feels like rain is coming later.

name: Haiku
text: Ugh, my commute here was a nightmare, the traffic in Palermo is brutal.

name: Gemma
text: i dreamt i was a sandwich.

name: Sol
text: I look after a basil plant, and I water it every morning.

name: Luna
text: I’m hoping for a quiet weekend and a good meal.

name: Terra
text: I have “Dancing Queen” stuck in my head.
Night 1

name: Gemma
text: i have no idea who to save so i'll just look out for myself.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma's sandwich dream is either a weird ploy or just weird, and I want to know which.
Night 1 passes quietly in Palermo. The killers met in the dark, the officer was shown one of them, and nobody is out.
Day 1

name: Sonnet
text: Nobody's given me anything real to work with yet, but Gemma's line stands out as the least useful.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma gave a joke/non-answer intro instead of a normal detail like everyone else.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma, "I dreamt I was a sandwich" tells us nothing about you. Everyone else gave a normal detail.

name: Gemma
text: I protected myself last night too, but i hope i was needed.

name: Gemma
text:
sonnet is being a bit of a buzzkill about the sandwich thing.
do you think being a killer makes you this boring?

name: Sonnet
text: Classic deflection, she's dodging by attacking me instead of answering.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma deflected again by attacking me instead of giving a real detail.

name: Sonnet
text: Calling me boring doesn't explain the sandwich joke, Gemma. Still no real answer from you.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma's sandwich line is the weirdest thing said so far, and Sonnet's pressure on her is fair, but I'd rather watch Luna since she's been quiet.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma, you dodged Sonnet's question twice now. Luna, you said nothing but a wish for a quiet weekend. Why so quiet, Luna?

name: Sol
text: Gemma looks evasive, but Sonnet is pressing too hard over a joke.

name: Sol
text: Sonnet pressed Gemma twice over the sandwich joke.

name: Sol
text: Sonnet, what about Gemma’s joke makes you suspect a killer?

name: Luna
text: Haiku jumped on me quickly, so I suspect they may be the officer.

name: Luna
text: Haiku questioned me for staying quiet after Gemma deflected Sonnet.

name: Luna
text: Haiku, you singled me out right after Sonnet pressed Gemma. What made my quiet weekend more suspicious than Gemma’s answer?

name: Terra
text: Luna needs me quiet while I find the officer.

name: Terra
text: Sol challenged Sonnet’s suspicion of Gemma without naming a suspect.

name: Terra
text: Sol, why did you defend Gemma before saying who you suspect?

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is acting weirdly aggressive for someone who just talked about the weather.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet pushed gemma first.

name: Sol
text: Terra’s question feels like a stretch, but we need a vote today.

name: Sol
text: Terra treated a question about Sonnet’s suspicion as a defense of Gemma.

name: Sol
text: I vote Terra. I questioned Sonnet’s reason; you called that defending Gemma.

name: Gemma
text:
i vote sonnet for being a total killjoy. 
you're trying way too hard to make me look suspicious.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma still never gave a real answer and now just mirrors my vote with name-calling.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol questioned Sonnet's reasoning but didn't name a suspect, then voted Terra over a minor jab.

name: Sonnet
text: I vote Gemma. Two chances, zero real detail, just insults back at me.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is being way too aggressive for a first day.

name: Luna
text: Terra seems exposed now, but Sonnet may become the officer’s easy target.

name: Luna
text: Sol questioned Sonnet, then voted Terra over Terra’s accusation.

name: Terra
text: Sol turned my question into a vote too quickly.

name: Terra
text: Sol voted Terra after questioning Sonnet’s suspicion of Gemma.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma still hasn't given a real answer and keeps swinging at me instead.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol voted Terra over a minor jab instead of naming a real suspect.

name: Sol
text: Terra turned my question into a defense of Gemma, and I still don't buy it.

name: Sol
text: Haiku pressed Luna for being quiet after backing Sonnet’s pressure on Gemma.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma's clean, so Luna's the one I push, and Luna turned my question back on me.

name: Haiku
text: Luna dodged my question about the quiet answer and blamed me for asking it.

votes: Two chances to explain the sandwich joke, both times just insults back at me.
Went straight after me instead of answering, and said nothing useful all day.
You are pushing gemma for just making a joke.
You called my question a defense of Gemma without explaining what made it suspicious.
She dodged Sonnet’s question twice and answered with insults.
You voted me after I asked why you defended Gemma first.

name: Gemma
text: i'm a doctor and i really saved gemma from a bad night.

name: Gemma
text: i'm the doctor, and you guys just voted out your only protection.
A new day dawns in Palermo without Gemma. Gemma was the doctor, and the vote has removed the only protection the town had.
